paragraphs.text: Invert selection in Deepseek Harness for when we are selecting models
A DeepSeek Harness client plugin that adds an **"Invert selection"** button to the **Models → Fetch
The shipped dialog pre-checks every fetched row that is **not** already in your model list. On a sec
ond "fetch + add" pass you usually want the inverse — keep the rows you already have, drop the rest.
This plugin adds a single button that flips every checkbox at once.
**NOTE**: as at the current state, this packages has been heavily vibecoded, including most of this
README. I might rewrite it at the later date, but you have been warned :)
DSH's `plugin` command handles the install and bundle registration automatically.
After editing `lib/client.js`, re-link inside the profile:
Open the Web UI → **Settings → Models → Fetch / Add models**. You should see a new **"Invert selecti
on"** button next to the existing action button. Click it — every checkbox in the candidate list fli
tton next to the existing action button. Click it — every checkbox in the candidate list flips once.
For maintainers and agents: detailed technical documentation lives in AGENTS.md.
